choices.text: “I needed one clean hit. With those two contacts tied together, it hits harder. I could have stopped there.”
“I pressed INVERT. Heard the deck start recording. The thing still hit me. What I had loaded was gone. It had put a little piece of the attack in its place.”
“When it says HOT, give it a beat. HOLD will cool the wire. A strong take can still push it. Pull the lead if you need to know what will happen.”
“Only the one you have loaded for the fight. I played the filed tapes back twice to make sure.”
